# Apple Notes MCP Server

> A Model Context Protocol server that enables AI assistants to read, search, create, edit, and export Apple Notes on macOS.

Runs locally on macOS using AppleScript and Apple Shortcuts. Install via npx or as a plugin for Claude Code and Codex. Provides tools for note management, folder organization, and exporting to Markdown, HTML, or JSON.

## Docs

- [Apple Notes MCP Server](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/README.md): Overview, quick start, features, tool reference, installation, configuration, security, and troubleshooting for the Apple Notes MCP server.
- [Apple Notes Technical Documentation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/TECHNICAL_NOTES.md): Research on Apple Notes data storage, AppleScript API, database access, protobuf formats, and known limitations for project improvement.
- [Apple Notes MCP - Improvement Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/TODO.md): Improvement roadmap tracking completed AppleScript surface gaps, new tool implementations, and future considerations for the Apple Notes MCP server.
- [AppleScript Limitations](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/docs/APPLESCRIPT-LIMITATIONS.md): Investigation of features missing from the AppleScript dictionary, verification methods, and workarounds using the private NoteStore database.
- [Full Disk Access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/docs/FULL-DISK-ACCESS.md): Tools requiring Full Disk Access, why it is needed for reading the SQLite store, and which operations work without it.
- [JXA (JavaScript for Automation) Research](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/docs/JXA_RESEARCH.md): Research comparing JXA and AppleScript performance, string escaping, and Unicode handling for Apple Notes automation tasks.
- [Markdown export templates](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/docs/markdown-templates.md): How to create, manage, and apply portable JSON templates for customizing Markdown note exports.
- [Node runtime & TCC permission stability](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/docs/NODE-RUNTIME-AND-TCC-PERMISSIONS.md): Why macOS repeatedly requests TCC permissions after Node updates, and how ad-hoc signing affects code identity.
- [apple-notes-mcp — Stability & Performance Audit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sweetrb/apple-notes-mcp/main/docs/STABILITY-PERF-AUDIT-2026-06-19.md): A historical audit of stability and performance issues in version 1.4.4, with all findings now resolved.
